输入 IPv4 或 IPv6 地址: Enter an IPv4 or IPv6 address
支持公网 IPv4 和 IPv6。请只输入地址，不要附加协议、端口或路径；私有、: Public IPv4 and IPv6 addresses are supported. Enter only the address, without a protocol, port or path. Private, loopback and reserved addresses cannot be used for public location lookups. Examples include 1.1.1.1 and 8.8.8.8; paste a complete address for IPv6. Addresses such as 192.168.x.x, 10.x.x.x and 127.0.0.1 are meaningful only on a local network and cannot identify a public location.
为什么多个数据源给出的归属地不同？: Why do sources report different locations?
各数据源的采集方式和更新时间不同。IP 归属地是网络地址的估计位置，不等同于设备: Sources use different collection methods and update schedules. IP geolocation estimates a network address's location, not a device's precise position. ISP names may refer to a data center or upstream network. Compare country, city, ISP and ASN instead of relying only on the city. Proxies, mobile networks, cloud servers and address reassignment can all create differences between database records and actual use.
ASN、运营商和地址类型分别是什么？: What are ASN, ISP and address type?
ASN 标识负责路由该地址的自治系统；运营商表示数据源记录的网络组织；IPv4、: An ASN identifies the autonomous system routing the address. ISP is the network organization recorded by the source. IPv4 and IPv6 indicate the protocol version. One ISP may have multiple ASNs and one ASN may span multiple cities. The registered organization, routing operator and end user are not always the same entity; an organization name does not identify a device or person.
为什么风险评分或部分字段没有显示？: Why are risk scores or some fields missing?
只有数据源实际返回的信息才会展示。缺少风险评分、经纬度或代理标记，不表示该 IP: Only information actually returned by sources is displayed. A missing risk score, coordinates or proxy flag does not mean the IP is safe or risky. Scores and VPN/proxy labels reflect a particular source's assessment and are not a standalone security conclusion. Fields may be absent because a source omitted them, a query failed or a service is not configured. Do not read “unknown” as “no” or zero risk.
如何查看当前网络的出口 IP？: How do I find my network's egress IP?
首页的 IPv4、IPv6 卡片会通过浏览器检测当前出口。需要查看详细归属信息时: The home page's IPv4 and IPv6 cards detect egress through your browser. Click an address for detailed location information. With a proxy or split routing, different sites may use different egress addresses. Use the home page's website routing results to choose the address to inspect.
最近查询保存在哪里，如何更新？: Where are recent lookups stored and how are they updated?
本浏览器保留最近 10 条成功查询及结果，点击历史直接读取缓存，再点击“查询”可: This browser keeps the last 10 successful lookups and their results. Clicking history reads the cached result; click “Look up” again to update. History is stored in localStorage in this browser and does not sync between devices. Clearing site data removes it. Queried addresses may also appear in the address bar and browser history.

WebRTC 通过 ICE/STUN 发现可用于点对点连接的地址。STUN 通常: WebRTC uses ICE/STUN to discover addresses for peer-to-peer connections. STUN usually uses UDP. If a proxy handles only TCP, candidates may expose another public egress. This page creates only a data channel and does not request camera or microphone permission.
UDP 是无连接传输协议。STUN 服务器把它观察到的公网映射地址返回给客户端。: UDP is a connectionless transport protocol. A STUN server returns the public mapped address it observes to the client. This tool uses Google and Cloudflare STUN, collects ICE candidates and compares them with HTTP egress. Local addresses hidden by mDNS are not reported as public IPs.
如何判断是否泄露了？: How can I tell if there is a leak?
出口不同仅说明 UDP 和 HTTP 路由不同，也可能是预期分流。请核对运营商、: Different egress only indicates different UDP and HTTP routes, which may be intentional. Check ISP, region and proxy rules. No public address may mean UDP is blocked or the browser restricted collection; this does not establish safety.
发现泄露了，怎么修？: How do I fix a leak?
检查客户端 UDP 转发、TUN 接管和 IPv6 规则。Firefox 可在: Check UDP forwarding, TUN traffic handling and IPv6 rules in your client. Firefox can disable media.peerconnection.enabled in about:config; Brave can disable non-proxied UDP. Disabling WebRTC affects video conferencing and similar features, so correcting proxy routing is preferable.
为什么代理模式和 TUN 模式检测结果不同？: Why do proxy and TUN modes give different results?
系统代理与虚拟网卡模式接管流量的范围不同。STUN 在某些代理模式下可能完全无法: System proxy and virtual network adapter modes handle different traffic scopes. STUN may be unable to send traffic in some proxy modes, while TUN mode can expose the actual UDP route. Check DNS as well; a single WebRTC result is not a complete privacy audit.

Examples: qq.com, 1.1.1.1 and AS15169. Subdomains such as www.qq.com may not have independent registration records; normally enter the registered domain, qq.com.
WHOIS 和 RDAP 有什么区别？: What is the difference between WHOIS and RDAP?
两者都用于查询注册信息。本页使用返回结构化数据的 RDAP；域名由注册局提供数据: Both retrieve registration information. This page uses structured RDAP data: registries supply domain records and regional internet registries supply IP and ASN records. The page displays identifiers, status, name servers, event dates and entities when returned. Available fields differ across registries. Use the raw RDAP view to inspect the full response.
为什么查询失败或没有结果？: Why did the lookup fail or return nothing?
域名后缀可能尚无可用 RDAP 服务，也可能遇到未注册域名、上游限流或连接超时。: The domain suffix may not have an available RDAP service, the domain may be unregistered, or upstream rate limits or timeouts may apply. A failed lookup does not mean the domain is available; check with a registrar. Verify spelling and format, then retry. If only one suffix fails, its registry service may be unsupported or temporarily unavailable. Do not repeatedly click to bypass upstream rate limits.
为什么看不到注册人或国家信息？: Why is registrant or country information missing?
上游可能未公开相关字段，或对联系人信息作了隐私处理。“未知”仅表示此次响应没有提: The source may omit these fields or redact contact details. “Unknown” only means the response did not provide data. A country in a domain record usually refers to registration or contact information, not the server location. Contact handles are not necessarily names; privacy proxies or registrar entities may appear instead of the registrant.
域名状态与 DNS 服务器代表什么？: What do domain status and name servers mean?
transfer prohibited 表示限制转移，delete prohib: “transfer prohibited” restricts transfers, “delete prohibited” restricts deletion, and “hold” suspends resolution. Name servers are the authoritative servers listed in registration data, not the website's current server IP. “client” usually indicates registrar restrictions and “server” registry restrictions. A transfer lock does not make a website inaccessible, and these name servers are not necessarily your current recursive DNS servers.
本浏览器分别保留最近 10 条 IP 和 WHOIS 成功查询。点击历史优先显示: This browser keeps the last 10 successful IP and WHOIS lookups separately. Selecting history shows saved results and timestamps; click “Look up” for fresh data. Clearing site data removes local history. A successful repeat lookup replaces the old result and moves it to the top. Entries beyond 10 are removed oldest first. The cache does not refresh in the background; look up again when registration, DNS or expiry details may have changed.

支持公网 IPv4 和 IPv6。请只输入地址，不要附加协议、端口或路径；私有、: Public IPv4 and IPv6 addresses are supported. Enter only the address, without a protocol, port or path. Private, loopback and reserved addresses cannot be used for public location lookups. Examples include 1.1.1.1 and 8.8.8.8; paste a complete address for IPv6. Addresses such as 192.168.x.x, 10.x.x.x and 127.0.0.1 are meaningful only on a local network and cannot identify a public location.
各数据源的采集方式和更新时间不同。IP 归属地是网络地址的估计位置，不等同于设备: Sources use different collection methods and update schedules. IP geolocation estimates a network address's location, not a device's precise position. ISP names may refer to a data center or upstream network. Compare country, city, ISP and ASN instead of relying only on the city. Proxies, mobile networks, cloud servers and address reassignment can all create differences between database records and actual use.
ASN 标识负责路由该地址的自治系统；运营商表示数据源记录的网络组织；IPv4、: An ASN identifies the autonomous system routing the address. ISP is the network organization recorded by the source. IPv4 and IPv6 indicate the protocol version. One ISP may have multiple ASNs and one ASN may span multiple cities. The registered organization, routing operator and end user are not always the same entity; an organization name does not identify a device or person.
只有数据源实际返回的信息才会展示。缺少风险评分、经纬度或代理标记，不表示该 IP: Only information actually returned by sources is displayed. A missing risk score, coordinates or proxy flag does not mean the IP is safe or risky. Scores and VPN/proxy labels reflect a particular source's assessment and are not a standalone security conclusion. Fields may be absent because a source omitted them, a query failed or a service is not configured. Do not read “unknown” as “no” or zero risk.
首页的 IPv4、IPv6 卡片会通过浏览器检测当前出口。需要查看详细归属信息时: The home page's IPv4 and IPv6 cards detect egress through your browser. Click an address for detailed location information. With a proxy or split routing, different sites may use different egress addresses. Use the home page's website routing results to choose the address to inspect.
本浏览器保留最近 10 条成功查询及结果，点击历史直接读取缓存，再点击“查询”可: This browser keeps the last 10 successful lookups and their results. Clicking history reads the cached result; click “Look up” again to update. History is stored in localStorage in this browser and does not sync between devices. Clearing site data removes it. Queried addresses may also appear in the address bar and browser history.

探测未取得有效响应（单次限时 1 秒），已跳过；可能超时、被内容拦截或受站点防护: No valid response within the one-second probe limit; skipped. The request may have timed out or been blocked by content or site protection.
网络类型来自 ip-api.com；非机房不等于住宅。: Network type from ip-api.com; non-hosting does not prove residential use.
BGP 前缀来自 RIPE RIS，注册地址范围来自 RDAP，两者可能不同。: BGP prefixes come from RIPE RIS; registered ranges come from RDAP. They may differ.
RPKI 校验路由授权，不代表 IP 信誉；未声明不等于无效。: RPKI validates route authorization, not IP reputation. No ROA does not mean invalid.
信誉分 = 100 − 命中项权重之和。所有风险项均有数据才出分；未知不算安全。: Reputation = 100 minus the weights of flagged signals. All signals must be available before scoring; unknown does not mean safe. These rules are not statistically calibrated or an official AI platform risk score.
来源：ipwho.is / ip.sb（归属地）、RDAP（注册）、RIPEst: Sources: ipwho.is / ip.sb (location), RDAP (registration), RIPEstat (routing and PTR), ip-api.com (network type). Risk conclusions require available source data.
此处仅展示 ip-api.com 的类型标记，可能与其他数据库不同，不作为住宅或: This is the classification reported by ip-api.com. Sources may disagree; it is not a definitive residential or mobile classification.
评分与类型、风险标记均来自 Net.Coffee，直接展示接口结果，不使用本站旧: Score, network classification and risk flags are supplied by Net.Coffee. Results are displayed directly without the previous local scoring formula.
该评分不是 AI 平台官方评分；数据源未返回的字段显示未知。: This is not an official AI platform score. Missing source fields are shown as unknown.
IP 数据源返回的地址不匹配: The IP returned by the source does not match the requested address.
根据注册国家与定位国家是否一致判断: Based on whether registered and geolocated countries match
自治系统编号，用于标识对外宣告 IP 路由的网络组织，不等同于最终使用者。: An ASN identifies a network announcing IP routes, not its end users.
无类别域间路由记法，表示 IP 地址块。斜杠后的数字越小，范围越大；IPv4 /: CIDR describes an address block. A smaller prefix length means a larger block: IPv4 /24 contains 256 addresses; /16 contains 65,536.
反向 DNS 记录，将 IP 地址映射为域名。名称由网络运营方配置，不能单独证明: Reverse DNS maps an IP to a hostname. Operators configure these names; they alone do not establish residential or hosting use.
验证 IP 前缀与宣告 ASN 是否获得路由授权。有效表示匹配 ROA；未声明表: RPKI validates the prefix and announcing ASN against route authorizations. No ROA means no relevant record, not an invalid or malicious route.
私有、保留或未分配等不应出现在公共互联网路由中的地址。未命中不代表该地址一定可访: Private, reserved or unallocated addresses that should not appear in public routing. A non-bogon address is not necessarily reachable.
该地址是否被识别为 VPN 出口。VPN 标记不等于恶意行为，未检测到也不保证没: Whether the IP is identified as a VPN exit. A VPN flag does not imply abuse; no detection does not rule out VPN use.
该地址是否被识别为 Tor 出口节点。此标记反映网络出口属性，不代表用户身份。: Whether the IP is identified as a Tor exit. This describes the exit network, not a user identity.
根据注册国家与定位国家是否一致判断。一致时显示原生 IP；国家不同也可能来自跨境: Compares registered and geolocated countries. Matching countries are labeled native. Differences can result from cross-border operations or database discrepancies.
网络组织申报的业务类型，例如 mixed 为混合网络、hosting 为托管网络: The network organization’s reported business type, such as mixed or hosting. It does not establish an individual IP’s use.
该 ASN 关联的 IPv4 地址数量，不是当前地址段的大小，也不代表在线设备数: The IPv4 address count associated with the ASN, not the size of this block or the number of online devices.
网络组织层面的带宽估计或申报档位，不是当前 IP 的实测下载速度。: An organization-level bandwidth estimate or reported range, not the measured download speed of this IP.
ASN 的注册或分配日期，不是当前 IP 地址块、宽带账户或设备的启用日期。: The ASN registration or allocation date, not the activation date of an IP block, broadband account or device.
该 IP 是否被识别为代理出口。检测结果可能受数据库覆盖和更新时间影响。: Whether the address is identified as a proxy exit. Database coverage and update frequency affect detection.
蜜罐记录扫描、攻击或自动化访问等活动形成的威胁信号。没有返回数据时显示未知，不能: Threat signals from honeypots observing scans, attacks or automated traffic. Missing data means unknown, not a clean result.
反映数据源记录的滥用信号强弱；分值及等级使用该字段自身的尺度，不等于顶部的 0–: The strength of reported abuse signals. This field uses its own scale, separate from the 0–100 reputation score.
数据源对其访问评估的置信程度，不是服务可用率，也不是成功访问 AI 平台的概率。: The provider’s confidence in its assessment, not service uptime or the probability of accessing an AI platform.
数据源关联到的其他网络地址，不代表与当前 IP 属于同一台服务器或同一位用户。: Other associated network addresses, not necessarily on the same server or used by the same person.
0–100 的综合信誉指标，越高表示数据源评估的风险越低。该分数不能保证网站可用: A composite 0–100 reputation indicator. Higher means lower assessed risk, but does not guarantee access or represent an AI platform’s official verdict.
